book.name: Matius
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I MATIUS

content: Yesus niwawa mae' ni Pilatus
Sarataa boomo ilio, giigii' tanaasna imam tia motu-motu'ana lipu' Yahudi nobarimpungmo ka' nopoosangadai mampapatei i Yesus.
Raaya'a numungumo i Ia kasi nangawawa mae' ni Pilatus men gubernuur na libutan iya'a.
Yudas nolapus
Sarataa i Yudas men nongorookon i Yesus nimiile' se' i Yesus nikana'imo ukuman pate, ia ninsosolmo. Kasi ia nungule'kon doi' salaka' men tolumpulo' iya'a na tanaasna imam tia motu-motu'a,
ka' norobu taena, “Yaku' nodosaonmo gause nongorookon rara'na mian men sian sala'na.” Kasee ia simbati i raaya'a taena, “Upa a urusanmai tia kanono'? Kanono' urusaan suuwung!”
Mbaka' ia nambalo'konmo doi' salaka' iya'a na lalomna Laiganna Alaata'ala, kasi nomae' nintipegot.
Tanaasna imam nangalamo doi' salaka' iya'a ka' norobu taena, “Sian poturangon monsoopkon doi' kani'i na pundi, gause doi' kani'i doi'na rara'.”
Noko daa i raaya'a nopoosangadai, raaya'a namba'ilikonmo doi' iya'a ningili tano' men ngaanon Tano'na Tukang Kuren. Tano' iya'a nisidakon tampat bo baleananna mian men tumaka.
Mbali' iya'a, pataka koini'i tano' iya'a ngaanion Tano' Rara'.

Tempo i raaya'a mangawawau men koiya'a mbaka' nosidamo a wurungna Tumpu koi men ia tadulkon i Nabii Yeremia taena, “Raaya'a nangalabot tolumpulo' doi' salaka', ya'amo a ilina men ia poosangadaikonmo lipu' Israel bo pambayar i Ia.
Ka' doi' iya'a ia pakemo i raaya'a bo pingili Tano'na Tukang Kuren koi men ia potookonmo Tumpu na ingku'.”
Yesus ia paresa i Pilatus
Kasi i Yesus niwawa na gubernuurna libutan iya'a. Ka' gubernuur iya'a nimikirawari i ia taena, “Koomo a tomundo'na lipu' Yahudi?” Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Koi nooro'o men taemuu.”
Kasee tempo tanaasna imam tia motu-motu'a mambantilkon giigii' men raitkononna i raaya'a ni Yesus, Ia sian santaa' ninsimbati.
Mbaka' i Pilatus norobumo ni Yesus taena, “Sian rongoroon se' biai' a men raitkononna mian karaani'i na Ko'oom?”
Kasee i Ia sian ninsimbati santaa'po, tamban gubernuur iya'a nosamba' tuu'.
Yesus ni'ukum pate
Sanda' ramean Paska, delena gubernuur iya'a sabole munguarkon sa'angu' mian na tarungkuan koi men ko'uusionna mian.
Ka' na tempo iya'a isian sa'angu' mian men nitarungku. Ngaanna i Barabas. Ia tongaan ba'idek tuu' a gau'na.
Tempo mian biai' nobarimpung na tampat iya'a, ai Pilatus norobumo na ko'ona i raaya'a taena, “Ime a men ko'uusmuu bo uarkononku bo ko'omuu, Barabas kabai se' i Yesus men ngaanon i Kristus?”
Pilatus inti-inti'i se' i raaya'a nangkalaakkon i Yesus gause i raaya'a kokoo'ankon i Yesus.

Sarataa i Pilatus no'umoruang na oruangan pungukumian, boroki'na nomotuun i ia taena, “Alia i koo mangawawau upapo na mian men sian sala'na kanono', gause i Ia i yaku' nunsuri marepa tuu' na lalomna ipionku rimputu'.”
Kasee tanaasna imam ka' motu-motu'a nomosuu' mian biai' mama'ase' ni Pilatus kada' i Barabas a uarkonon ka' i Yesus a ukumon pate.
Gubernuur iya'a norobu na ko'ona i raaya'a taena, “Na rurua' mian kani'i, ime a men ko'uusmuu uarkonon bo ko'omuu?” Ia simbati i raaya'a taena, “Barabas.”
Taena i Pilatus na ko'ona i raaya'a, “Ansee ka' koiya'a upaionkumo ni Yesus men ngaanon i Kristus?” Raaya'a giigii' nangkakaro' taena, “Ia tio saliipkonon!”
Taena i Pilatus, “Kasee idek upa a men Ia poko wawaumo?” Kasee i raaya'a tongko' kaekae' dodoa mangkakaro' taena, “Ia tio saliipkonon!”

Sarataa i Pilatus nunsuri se' ia sian moko ba'upa, ka' mian biai' kaekae' dodoa gora', ia nangalamo weer ka' ningoso' na aropna mian biai' ka' norobu taena, “Yaku' sian sala' na rara'na mian kani'i. Ya'a urusanmuu!”
Ka' giigii' mian ninsimbati taena, “Daa. Rara'-Na kaisi tia anakmai a bo pantaup!”
Kasi ia nunguarkon i Barabas bo ko'ona i raaya'a, ka' nomosuu' mian mansasali i Yesus, kasi nongorookon bo saliipkonon.
Yesus ni'iroki
Surudaduna gubernuur nangawawamo i Yesus na laiganna gubernuur, kasi nengeleelo' giigii' surudadu barimpung mintikumi i Yesus.
Raaya'a nungukatimo pakean-Na ka' nimpisoki i Ia tia juba kakamumu'.

Raaya'a nanganam sa'angu' likok ruri' niwawau koi mahkota ka' nunsulon na takala'-Na, kasi nomo'intoni tokon na lima-Na uanan. Kasi i raaya'a nobanintuur ka' ningiroki i Ia, taena, “Tabea', oo tomundo'na lipu' Yahudi!”
Raaya'a ninginori i Ia ka' nangala tokon iya'a kasi nomoolkon na takala'-Na.
Noko daa i Yesus nibibiani, ia ukatimo i raaya'a a juba-Na, kasi nipopisokikon a pakean-Na soosoodo. Kasi i raaya'a nangawawa i Ia umuar bo saliipkonon.
Yesus nisaliipkon
Sarataa i raaya'a mae' umuar na kota, raaya'a nopootuungmo sa'angu' mian samba Kirene men ngaanna i Simon. Mian iya'a ia pakisaamo i raaya'a mamasa'an saliip ni Yesus.
Mbaka' notakamo i raaya'a na sa'angu' tampat men ngaanon Golgota, aratina: Tampat Lamasna Takala'.
Kasi i raaya'a nantarai i Ia minginum anggur men nibauri sopoyu'. Sarataa Ia nangananami, Ia nobude' ninginum.
Noko daa nansaliipkon i Ia, raaya'a nungundimo pakean-Na ka' nongobo-obos.
Kasi i raaya'a no'umoruang indo'o mandagai i Ia.
Ka' na wawona takala'-Na nipakampa'i tulisan men mangaan nongko'upa se' i Ia ni'ukum. Tulisan iya'a koi kani'imari: Ni'imo i Yesus Tomundo'na Lipu' Yahudi.
Singkat tii Ia uga' isian rurua' mian puraga nisaliipkon, sa'angu' paraas uanan-Na ka' sa'angu' paraas kauri'-Na.
Mian men lumiu inda'a ningililokkon takala'na ka' mingiroki i Yesus.

Raaya'a norobu taena, “Wee i Koo men bo munguruntuni Laiganna Alaata'ala ka' tongko' tolu' ilio pokoowonmo patindongon soosoodo. Salamatkon a wakaam. Kalu i Koo Anakna Alaata'ala, palau na saliiwip kanono'!”
Koiya'a uga' tanaasna imam tia wawa ukum Torat ka' motu-motu'a ningiroki i Ia ka' nangaan taena,
“Mian sambana pokoon-Na salamatkonon, kasee waka-Na sian pokoon-Na salamatkonon! Kalu i Ia tomundo'na lipu' Israel, porena i Ia malau na saliip iya'a kada' i kai parasaya na Ko'ona!
Ia mamarasayakon waka-Na na Alaata'ala. Sobii Alaata'alasi a pansalamatkon i Ia koini'i kalu Alaata'ala mo'lingu'kon i Ia. Gause i Ia isian nangaan se' i Ia Anakna Alaata'ala.”
Koiya'a uga' mian puraga men nisaliipkon tii Ia uga' mangaani.
Yesus nolapus
Muntumbei jaam duablaas, nopintungmo a longkop libutan iya'a pataka jaam tiga.
Toro jaam tiga i Yesus nangkakaro'mo men boolak tae-Na, “Eli! Eli! Lema sabakhtani?” Aratina: Alaata'alang-Ku! Alaata'alang-Ku! Nongko'upa se' i Kuu mandalai i Yaku'?
Nomorongor iya'a toropii mian men potokerer iraando'o norobu taena, “Ia mengeleelo' i Elia.”
Sa'angu' mian men isian tii raaya'a nomae'mo pasa-pasasara' nangala garanggan mongura' ka' nongorom na anggur makarang, kasi ia potoor na kau ka' nisoorkon waara'a, mimi'inumi i Yesus.
Kasee mian sambana norobu taena, “Alia. Mai kita piile'a, too i Elia taka mansalamatkon i Ia.”
Yesus nangkakaro'mo boolak soosoodo kasi nolapus.
Singkat iya'a, toik men pongola'i olisna Laiganna Alaata'ala nokoberak rua' inda'ana tudun indo'ona. Isian lili' ka' buu'na watu kinobotakmo.
Baleanan kinobongkatian ka' biai' a mian men malolo' na Tumpu men nolapusmo notuo'mo soosoodo.
Ka' noko daa i Yesus tumuo' soosoodo, raaya'a uga' umuar na baleanan, kasi minsoop na Yerusalem, kota molinas, ka' mintipiile' na mian biai'.
Tanaasna surudadu tia surudaduna men mandagai i Yesus nolayaonmo tuu'. Sarataa i raaya'a nunsuri lili' ka' upa men nosida, raaya'a norobumo taena, “Mian kani'i tuutuu' Anakna Alaata'ala!”
Isian uga' indo'o biai' a wiwine men montoa'i na ko'oloaan. Wiwine iraaya'a a men nongololo' i Yesus ka' nangakalesang ringkatpo na Galilea.
Isian i Maria Magdalena, ka' i Maria sina ni Yakobus tii Yusuf, ka' sinana anak ni Zebedeus, ka' isian uga' men sambana.
Yesus nitanom
Guntumalom notakamo a sa'angu' mian men kupangon, samba Arimatea. Ngaanna i Yusuf men uga' nosidamo murit ni Yesus.
Ia nomae'mo ni Pilatus ka' nama'ase' biibii ni Yesus. Mbaka' i Pilatus nomosuu'mo mianna kada' biibii ni Yesus iya'a rookonon na ko'ona.
Kasi i Yusuf nangala biibii iya'a ka' nambalun tia toik pobalun biibii men bubulak maloe'. Pobalun iya'a, toik lenang a niwawau.
Ia nomotokolmo biibii iya'a na baleanan u'uru men nipa'atkon na buu'na watu. Noko daa iya'a, ia ningilinda'mo watu balaki' ka' nongompodi soopanna baleanan iya'a, kasi ia nomae'.
Kasee Maria Magdalena tii Maria men sambanaan moraando'o poto'oruang na baleanan.
Baleanan ni Yesus nidagai
Koi liilana, noko daa ilio batoropotan, tanaasna imam tia mian Farisi notakamo ni Pilatus,
ka' nambantil taena, “Tuan, inau'onmai se' tempo i tukang borek dauga' tumuo', Ia isian norobu tae-Na, ‘Moko daa tolu' ilio, Yaku' bo tumuo' soosoodo.’

Mbali' iya'a, posuu'kon mian mandagai baleanan iya'a pataka ilio kotolu'na, dako' murit-Na taka mamangan biibii-Na ka' mambantilkon na mian se' i Ia nipotuo'imo noko daa lapus. Ka' pimborekan men kokomburi'anna kani'i ba'idek tuu' tia men olukon.”
Taena i Pilatus na ko'ona i raaya'a, “Karaani'i a surudadu bo pandagaimuu. Rae' ka' dagai a baleanan iya'a pore-pore.”
Mbaka' i raaya'a nomae'mo tia surudadu, ka' i raaya'a nensegelmo watu men nongompodi baleanan iya'a ka' nandagai dako' singaonna mian.
